resolved_conflicts.explanation: Two listings date the destruction to 1958 and give no cause. The Forest Lookouts page says only Removed, with no year. The story gives 1958 as the year two sources name and reports the third page's wording.

sources.title: Wall Mountain Lookout – Idaho Fire Lookouts

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: gone, destroyed 1958, Kaniksu NF, Boundary County. Two sources agree on a 30-foot L-4 tower built in 1937, but the Forest Lookouts page says only Removed, with no date. The 1933 staff name (Frank Heath) predates the 1937 build on the same page, and the story reports this without resolving it. Staffing comes only from three names, with no dates of service. No source describes the site today and no access status was found, so access is left out. Searched twice; no photo with a license was found.
